# Canpolat Kaya - Full-Stack Developer & AI Automation Specialist

> Canpolat Kaya specializes in high-performance web scraping architectures, custom AI automations, scalable REST APIs, and production-grade Next.js web applications.

## Core Technical Services

- [Web Scraping & Data Harvesting Systems](https://canpolatkaya.com/hizmetler/web-scraping): Autonomous data collection, Playwright/Python browser automation, proxy rotation, anti-bot bypass strategies (PerimeterX, Cloudflare), and structured data pipelines.
- [AI Automation & Agent Workflows](https://canpolatkaya.com/hizmetler/yapay-zeka-otomasyon): Enterprise LLM integrations, deterministic AI agent workflows, business process automations, and custom API-driven intelligence layers.
- [Custom Software Development](https://canpolatkaya.com/hizmetler/ozel-yazilim-gelistirme): Tailored web applications, internal operational dashboards, robust backend microservices, and end-to-end software architectures.
- [High-Performance API Development](https://canpolatkaya.com/hizmetler/api-gelistirme): Production RESTful APIs built with Python FastAPI and Node.js, Redis caching layers, PostgreSQL/MongoDB schemas, and secure authentication.
- [Modern Next.js Web Development](https://canpolatkaya.com/hizmetler/nextjs-gelistirme): Accessible, lightning-fast, and GEO/SEO-optimized web applications with Next.js App Router, React 19, and TypeScript.

## Featured Portfolio Projects

- [Haber Portalı](https://canpolatkaya.com/projeler/haber-portali): Cloud-based autonomous news aggregation engine and DaaS (Data as a Service) platform built with Next.js, Node.js, Redis, and PostgreSQL.
- [BIST AI](https://canpolatkaya.com/projeler/bist-ai): Real-time stock market data analytics platform processing Borsa Istanbul ticker data with machine learning scoring using Python, FastAPI, Docker, and Redis.
- [EcoTrace](https://github.com/CanKStar0/EcoTrace): Open-source Python library to track code execution carbon emissions and energy consumption with zero configuration.
- [Zillow-Stealth-Scraper](https://github.com/CanKStar0): JavaScript/Playwright scraper engine featuring ML-based ghost cursor movements and anti-bot mitigation.

## Knowledge Base & Architecture Guides

- [Web Scraping Architecture & Anti-Bot Bypass](https://canpolatkaya.com/blog): Comprehensive technical guides on Playwright, anti-bot handling, proxy distribution, and scalable scraping pipelines.
- [AI Integration & Agentic Systems](https://canpolatkaya.com/blog): Architecture blueprints for connecting large language models (LLMs) to enterprise databases and microservices.
- [Next.js & Modern Frontend Engineering](https://canpolatkaya.com/blog): Production performance optimization, React 19 Server Components, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
